maya: Heads up — main CI just turned red after the recent merge (automerge). integration/runtime-smoke-alloc failed on shard 4. https://ci.redwood/runs/1759876543 :rotating_light:
maya: quick glance at logs shows repeated ConnectionResetError from grpc_streamer while streaming KV cache warmup.
tj: @maya grabbing, can you paste the tail of the log?
maya: pasted below:
```
ERROR grpc_streamer.go:142 stream send failed: EOF
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/runtime/e2e_kvalloc.py", line 88, in test_kv_cache_eviction
    resp = client.stream(request)
  File "grpc/_channel.py", line 256, in _stream_recv
ConnectionResetError: [Errno 104] Connection reset by peer
```
sam: that looks like an intermittent network/driver drop between worker and router. any node ids?
maya: node: gpu-worker-17 shard=4, kernel=nv-quant-2
deploy-bot: Re-run requested by @tj: ./ci/rerun integration/runtime-smoke-alloc --shard 4
tj: kicked a rerun. also can someone check if the last commit touched gateway or network code? @jen
jen: checked the diff — only touched tokenizer caching and a comment in router.go, nothing that should affect grpc streams.
oscar: @tj I'll pull the node logs (gpu-worker-17) and dmesg, might be a driver reset or OOM.
tj: if rerun passes we can close. if it flakes twice in a row we should bisect or revert the merge.
maya: rerun queued: https://ci.redwood/run/1759876559
infra-bot: rerun finished: failed (same error) :rotating_light:
sam: ok that's two failures. @oscar what do you see on the node?
oscar: saw NVRM driver message around the same time: "NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:01:00): 79". grpc_streamer logs show keepalive resets and repeated connection closes.
tj: seems like driver/hardware resets causing connection drops. recommendation: quarantine gpu-worker-17 from the CI pool and rerun shard on a different node.
jen: I can write a small retry in the stream path as a short-term mitigation, but that's a bandaid. prefer to quarantine the node and open an SRE ticket.
maya: who can quarantine now? @jen or infra-sre?
tj: @jen please mark node out of rotation: ./infra/node-drain gpu-worker-17 && ./infra/remove-from-pool gpu-worker-17
jen: done — node drained and removed from pool.
deploy-bot: re-triggering job on new node: ./ci/rerun integration/runtime-smoke-alloc --shard 4 --avoid gpu-worker-17
deploy-bot: rerun finished: success :white_check_mark:
maya: nice. I'm marking this as a flake caused by driver Xid 79 and opening an incident ticket to get hardware checked. I'll follow up with SRE.
tj: thanks y'all. note for follow-up: if this repeats on other nodes escalate to SRE immediately and consider temporary rollback of the merge if it impacts rollouts.
maya: @oscar dropping collected logs and dmesg into the incident ticket.
oscar: done, ticket INC-2026-0423 created.
maya: :thumbsup:
